elements.element: Transition assistance provided on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) ... provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Transition assistance duration up to 6 months
elements.evidence: for a period of up to six (6) months
return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data and other Company data in HDI's possession or control

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format

elements.evidence: within 30 days after expiry or termination
(c) thereafter delete such Content, information and data from its systems
certify such deletion to the Company in writing
for a period of up to six (6) months
in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination

reasons: The Agreement contained no exit mechanic; the inserted Section 4.3 is a concise addition that supplies every preferred atomic element: up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Company data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and deletion with written certification thereafter.

The 'at the Company's request' condition attaches only to limb (a) transition assistance (which we control and would not want forced on us); the mandatory data-return and deletion/certification obligations in limbs (b) and (c) are unconditional, so the request condition does not swallow the return duty.

'reasonable' qualifying transition assistance is a minor softening noted only in the rationale, not a material failure; the duration, rates, format, 30-day deadline, deletion and certification are all express.
Fallback is also independently satisfied (six months exceeds 90 days; export within 30 days), but the clause sits at the preferred level.
No unrelated commercial term is altered, no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced, and the existing Sections 4.1 and 4.1(c) remain untouched and effective.
